messages:
jordan_acme: Hey support — after rotating our project service key the console still shows the 500 promo credits but API requests using the new key are being billed normally. Project: proj-acme-88. Blocking our payment flow, can you check?

maya_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the project id + last 4 of the service key and a sample request id? Also did you move the project between orgs recently? :thinking_face:

jordan_acme: proj-acme-88, key last4 ab12, sample request id req_01Hk2Xx9. We only rotated the key via Console -> Project Settings, no org moves.

billing-bot: [automated] Billing sync snapshot for proj-acme-88 — promo_balance: 500, applied_to_api: false

maya_support: Thanks — I'm kicking off an internal resync and checking the mapping table. My hunch is the service-key -> project mapping didn't propagate to billing-mapper after the rotate. Escalating to infra if resync fails. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam_engineer: Heads up — I see a 404 in the mapping service logs for `service_key: sk_...ab12` at 2026-02-14T12:02:03Z. Quick repro I ran locally: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_ab12" \ 
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/usage?project=proj-acme-88" 
# API returns 200 and usage payload, but billing-mapper returns project:null for that key
```

liam_engineer: Looks like the console rotate workflow updated the UI metadata but a transient DB lock caused the billing-mapper write to fail. Two remediation paths: force resync to recreate the mapping row, or manual backfill of the mapping row and re-run the credits application job.

maya_support: Options for the customer: 1) quick resync (non-blocking) — usually fixes mapping in ~10m. 2) manual backfill if resync fails — ETA 3-4h and requires a short maintenance window. Do you want us to run the quick resync now?

jordan_acme: Yes please run the quick resync now — our alerts are firing and dev CI is blocked.

ops_julie: Running internal job: POST /internal/v1/credits/resync with payload `{ project_id: "proj-acme-88", reason: "service_key_rotate" }`. Job queued id job_7732. Link: https://internal.redwood/jobs/job_7732 :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: [automated] Job job_7732 completed: mapping_row_created service_key->proj-acme-88, promo_applied: true

jordan_acme: Confirmed — next API call used promo balance and logged usage against the project. Thanks everyone :clap: If anything odd pops up we'll re-open the thread.
